title: Instant quote calculator for full-truckload shipments
body:
As a prospective shipper, I want an instant price quote for a full-truckload shipment on the Lumen Freight website so I can book without waiting for a sales rep.

**Acceptance criteria**

* Inputs: origin ZIP, destination ZIP, pickup date, equipment type (dry van, reefer, flatbed)
* Quote is based on lane market rate, fuel surcharge and a configurable margin
* Quote is valid for 24 hours and can be converted to a booking in one click
* Quotes are logged for the sales team to follow up

**Out of scope:** LTL and multi-stop quoting (separate story).
author: Abraham AIProject
